programme.title: Hatari
programme.desc: Director Howard Hawks reteams with John Wayne, who heads a group of highly skilled professional game hunters in Africa. Only they don’t use bullets – they capture the ferocious big game with strong rope and cameras for zoos and circus attractions.

programme.title: To Catch a Thief
programme.desc: A famous cat burglar who has retired to the Riviera catches a thief imitating his old style.

programme.title: Father Goose
programme.desc: Cary Grant stars in one of his funniest roles as a boozy beachcomber sitting out WWII in peace - until the Allies recruit him to be a lookout on the South Pacific isle.

programme.title: Top Gun
programme.desc: Tom Cruise is superb as Maverick Mitchell, a young flyer who's out to become the best. And Kelly McGillis plays the instructor who teaches Maverick a few things you can't learn in a classroom.

programme.title: Top Gun: Maverick
programme.desc: Pete "Maverick" Mitchell keeps pushing the envelope after years of service as one of the Navy's top aviators. He must soon confront the past while training a new squad of graduates for a dangerous mission that demands the ultimate sacrifice.

programme.title: XXX
programme.desc: Xander Cage is a notorious underground thrill-seeker deemed untouchable by the law. But when NSA Agent Gibbsons convinces Cage to infiltrate a ruthless Russian crime ring, this new breed of secret agent takes down the enemies of justice with a vengeance.

programme.title: You're Next
programme.desc: The Davisons' family reunion goes awry when their home comes under siege by a mask-wearing team of crossbow-bearing assailants.

programme.title: Hansel and Gretel: Witch Hunters
programme.desc: Get ready for a twisted take on the classic tale as Hansel and Gretel have turned pro, coping with the trauma of their childhood captivity by slaying witches for hire.

programme.title: World War Z
programme.desc: World War Z is the fast-paced, pulse-pounding epic of the potential last days of the human race. Former United Nations employee Gerry Lane (Brad Pitt) is called in to help stop the pandemic that has spread around the world.

programme.title: Amistad
programme.desc: AMISTAD is about a 1839 mutiny onboard a slave ship that is traveling towards the Northeast Coast of America. Much of the story involves a court-room drama about the slave who led the revolt.

programme.title: Gemini Man
programme.desc: Will Smith stars in the nonstop action thrill-ride from Academy Award®-winning director Ang Lee. Retired hitman (Smith) is forced on the run and finds himself hunted by his ultimate adversary - a younger clone of himself.

programme.title: After Earth
programme.desc: A crash landing leaves Kitai Raige (Jaden Smith) and his legendary father Cypher (Will Smith) stranded on Earth, 1,000 years after cataclysmic events forced humanity’s escape.

programme.title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
programme.desc: When an interdimensional rupture unravels reality, an unlikely hero (Michelle Yeoh) must channel her newfound powers to fight bizarre and bewildering dangers from the multiverse as the fate of everything hangs in the balance.

programme.title: Master Z: Ip Man Legacy
programme.desc: Legendary action director Yuen Woo Ping draws on a stellar cast (Michelle Yeoh, Dave Bautista, Tony Jaa, and Max Zhang) to create a hard-hitting martial arts blast worthy of its place in the celebrated IP MAN universe.

programme.title: Wing Chun
programme.desc: Wing Chun, a talented martial artist, decides to fight against horse thieves in the village to receive respect from the villagers.

programme.title: Jackass Presents: Bad Grandpa
programme.desc: Johnny Knoxville reprises his jackass role as 86-year-old Irving Zisman in the story of an old man saddled with the care of his grandson. The two hustle their way across America on an outrageous road trip pranking unsuspecting, real-life people.

programme.title: Jackass: The Movie
programme.desc: All the jackasses you love from the MTV series are back performing stunts no one would let them pull on television.

programme.title: Jackass Number Two
programme.desc: Prepare yourself for fits of uncontrollable laughter and waves of nausea as the guys launch their battered bodies into an onslaught of absurd situations.

programme.title: Just Like Heaven
programme.desc: He's convinced she's a spirit. She's convinced she's still alive. As they search for the truth of Elizabeth's past, their relationship changes from resentment to romance.

programme.title: Julie & Julia
programme.desc: Julie & Julia, tells the true stories of how Julia Child's life and cookbook inspired fledgling writer Julie Powell to whip up 524 recipes in 365 days and introduce a new generation to the magic of French cooking.

programme.title: 50 First Dates
programme.desc: A playboy tries to win over the girl of his dreams when he discovers she has no short-term memory.

programme.title: Hannibal Rising
programme.desc: Young Hannibal moves in with his aunt and begins plotting revenge after his baby sister is killed during World War II. Based on Thomas Harris' novel.

programme.title: Hannibal
programme.desc: Dr. Hannibal Lecter (Anthony Hopkins) comes out of hiding to draw FBI Agent Clarice Starling (Julianne Moore) into a high-stakes battle that tests her strength, cunning...and loyalty. Gary Oldman, Ray Liotta and Giancarlo Giannini also star.

programme.title: Collateral
programme.desc: Vincent is a cool, calculating contract killer at the top of his game. Max is a cabbie with big dreams and no results. On this fateful night, Max has to transport Vincent on his next job - one night, five stops, five hits and a getaway.

programme.title: Hoosiers
programme.desc: A man gets a last-chance job coaching a small-town Indiana high-school basketball team and faces the dual challenge of bringing this underdog team to the 1951 state championship and redeeming himself from a mysterious past.

programme.title: Forrest Gump
programme.desc: Tom Hanks gives an astonishing performance as Forrest, an everyman whose simple innocence comes to embody a generation.

programme.title: Capote
programme.desc: In 1959, Truman Capote, learns about the horrific and senseless murder of a family of four in Kansas. As he digs deeper into the story, he is inspired to expand the project into what would be his greatest work, In Cold Blood.

programme.title: The Jade Pendant
programme.desc: The Old West becomes a battleground for power and revenge in this gripping epic based on true events. A young Chinese woman, Ying-Ying, finds herself on a boat to America after escaping the clutches of a bad arranged marriage.

programme.title: Frank and Jesse
programme.desc: After the defeat of the South in the Civil War and the murder of their younger brother, Frank and Jesse James seek their own brand of justice. As outlaws, they gain fame for their daring hold-ups of banks, trains, and stagecoaches.

programme.title: True Grit (2010)
programme.desc: True Grit is a powerful story of vengeance and valor set in an unforgiving and unpredictable frontier where justice is simple and mercy is rare.

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay and executive producer Steven Spielberg comes a thrilling battle between the heroic Autobots and the evil Decepticons. When their epic struggle comes to Earth, Sam Witwicky becomes mankind's last chance for survival.

programme.title: Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen
programme.desc: The battle for Earth continues when college-bound Sam Witwicky learns the truth about the ancient origins of the Transformers and must join in their continued battle against the Decepticons.

programme.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
programme.desc: A mysterious event from Earth's past threatens to ignite a war so big that the Transformers alone will not be able to save the planet. Sam Witwicky and the Autobots must fight against the darkness to defend our world from the Decepticons.

programme.title: In Too Deep
programme.desc: Officer Cole is assigned to infiltrate the syndicate of God, a deadly crime lord. But as Cole sinks deeper into God's crew, he begins to get in over his head, until the line that separates his true identity from his street persona begins to disappear.

programme.title: Moon
programme.desc: Sam Bell (Sam Rockwell) is nearing the completion of his 3-year-long contract with Lunar Industries, mining Earth's primary source of energy on the dark side of the moon.

programme.title: Flatliners
programme.desc: Are you afraid to die? Kiefer Sutherland isn't. He's an ambitious, charismatic medical student who persuades classmates Julia Roberts and Kevin Bacon to take part in a reckless experiment. Rated: R

programme.title: Saved!
programme.desc: Good girl Mary (Jena Malone) can't believe it when she gets pregnant by her newly-gay boyfriend. She also can't believe the actions of her popular, relentlessly devout best friend, Hilary Faye (Mandy Moore).

programme.title: Ghost World
programme.desc: The story of neo-cool Enid and Rebecca who, faced with graduation from high school take a hard look at the world they wryly observe. When Rebecca focuses her attention on mutual romantic fixation Josh, the girls friendship is forever changed.

programme.title: Clerks
programme.desc: The legendary indie film that launched the career of Kevin Smith and won over audiences with its raw energy, outrageous comedy, and a hip soundtrack. CLERKS features razor-sharp wit and the debut of pop-culture icons Jay and Silent Bob.

programme.title: Deliver Us from Evil (2014)
programme.desc: A NYPD officer (Eric Bana) and unconventional priest Mendoza (Edgar Ramírez) who join forces to investigate a series of disturbing & inexplicable crimes. Together, they must combat the possessions that are terrorizing their city before it's too late.

programme.title: The Witch
programme.desc: In 1630 New England, panic and despair envelops a farmer, his wife and their children when youngest son Samuel suddenly vanishes.

programme.title: The Blackcoat's Daughter
programme.desc: Two terrified girls (Emma Roberts, Kiernan Shipka) must battle a mysterious evil force when they get left behind at their boarding school over winter break in this chilling and suspenseful horror film.

programme.title: About Last Night (1986)
programme.desc: Rob Lowe doesn't want to get serious. Demi Moore doesn't want to get used. Together, they're an unforgettable couple in the sexy, contemporary comedy, ABOUT LAST NIGHT. Rating: R

programme.title: Over the Top
programme.desc: A Championship title, a huge cash award, and his son's love -- the greatest prize of all -- are at stake when Hawk battles his strongest enemy for everything he has ever wanted.

programme.title: First Blood
programme.desc: A soft-spoken Vietnam vet drifts into a small town looking for no trouble, but finds it in the form of a psychotic local sheriff who finds pleasure in hating him for no reason.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Ghost Protocol
programme.desc: Agent Ethan Hunt and his elite team go underground after a bombing implicates them as terrorists. While trying to clear their name, the team uncovers a plot to start a nuclear war.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Rogue Nation
programme.desc: Ethan and team take on their most impossible mission yet, eradicating the Syndicate - an International rogue organization as highly skilled as they are, committed to destroying the IMF.

programme.title: Super 8
programme.desc: In the summer of 1979, a group of friends in a small Ohio town witness a catastrophic train crash while making a Super 8 movie and soon suspect that it was not an accident.

programme.title: The Italian Job (2003)
programme.desc: The plan was flawless. The execution was perfect. Charlie Croker pulled off the crime of a lifetime. The one thing that he didn't plan on was being double-crossed.

programme.title: Witness
programme.desc: When a young Amish woman and her son get caught up in the murder of an undercover narcotic's agent, their saviour turns out to be hardened Philadelphia detective John Book.

programme.title: Snatch
programme.desc: A diamond heist gone haywire launches gangsters, bookies, and a dog on a rollicking ride through the rugged world of bare-knuckle boxing in search of the missing stone. Critically acclaimed comedy from Guy Ritchie.

programme.title: The Great Escape
programme.desc: Steve McQueen, James Garner, and Richard Attenborough headline a stellar cast in one of the most ingenious and suspenseful adventure films of all time as a team of Allied soldiers mount a daring escape from an inescapable Nazi POW camp.

programme.title: Overlord
programme.desc: Nothing can prepare you for the mind-blowing mayhem that is Overlord. Mega producer J.J. Abrams creates an insanely twisted thrill ride about a team of American troops who come face-to-face with Nazi super-soldiers unlike the world has ever seen.

programme.title: Remember
programme.desc: Everything is not what it seems in this riveting revenge thriller, where a relentless man will stop at nothing to find and kill the Nazi officer who murdered his family 70 years earlier in WWII.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
programme.desc: Ace Ventura Pet Detective is on the case to find the Miami Dolphins' missing mascot and quarterback Dan Marino. He goes eye to eye with sharks, stakes out the Miami Dolphins and woos and wows the ladies. He always gets his man...or beast.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls
programme.desc: Africa's the place where Ace is on the case, setting out to rescue an animal he loathes - a bat! If you're ready to laugh like a pack of hyenas, if you want more fun than an industrial-sized barrel of monkeys, you'll know what to do. Heed the call.

programme.title: Clueless
programme.desc: A US West Coast teen lifestyle parody centered around Cher, a popular high school girl who spends her days playing match-maker, helping her friends with fashion choices, and looking for a boyfriend.

programme.title: King Kong (1976)
programme.desc: A petroleum exploration expedition comes to an isolated island and encounters a colossal giant gorilla.

programme.title: Thunderbolt and Lightfoot
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood and Jeff Bridges lead a strong supporting cast in this offbeat crime caper about a colorful group of bank robbers determined to break into the fortress-like Montana Armored Depository.

programme.title: Lifeguard
programme.desc: A fifteen-year high school reunion gets an aging lifeguard thinking about becoming a salesman in this romantic drama starring Sam Elliott, Anne Archer and Kathleen Quinlan.

programme.title: Minority Report
programme.desc: In the future, a division of the police department has the technology to arrest killers before they commit crimes; however, the tables turn on one of the cops working within the division.

programme.title: The Phantom
programme.desc: The story begins as an expedition lands on the island of Bengalla, seeking the Skulls of Touganda. Believed to harness an energy force of power, they could spell disaster for mankind.

programme.title: Hellboy
programme.desc: After years of hiding from a society that shuns him, Hellboy and his team attempt to stop the resurrection of an ancient witch who once spread an unstoppable plague before she was locked away by the legendary King Arthur.

programme.title: The Machinist
programme.desc: Trevor hasn't slept in a year. When notes turn up in his home and hallucinations cause an injury, he tries to find out if there is a plot to drive him mad or his fatigue has robbed him of reason.

programme.title: The Lovely Bones
programme.desc: When 14-year-old Susie Salmon was murdered, she left unfinished life behind. But now from her place in a strange but beautiful in-between world, she must help her father catch her killer.

programme.title: Zodiac
programme.desc: Based on the Robert Graysmith books about the real life notorious Zodiac, a serial killer who terrorized San Francisco with a string of seemingly random murders during the 1960s and 1970s.

programme.title: Burning Bright
programme.desc: A man-eating tiger terrorizes a young woman (Briana Evigan) and her autistic brother during a hurricane.

programme.title: Rogue
programme.desc: A cynical American travel writer is among the stranded riverboat passengers who become fodder for a monstrous crocodile.

programme.title: Primal
programme.desc: Hunter and collector Frank Walsh sails to America with a priceless white jaguar and a dangerous political assassin. When the prisoner manages to break free, Walsh must utilize his expert skills to capture the dangerous killer -- not dead, but alive.

programme.title: Bait
programme.desc: A freak tsunami traps a group of people in a submerged grocery store. As they try to escape, they are hunted by white sharks that are hungry for meat.

programme.title: The People vs. Larry Flynt
programme.desc: Two-time Oscar winner Milos Forman directs Woody Harrelson and Courtney Love in this acclaimed film about "Hustler" publisher Larry Flynt. Rating: R

programme.title: Surfer, Dude
programme.desc: Longboarding soul surfer Steve Addington (Matthew McConaughey) returns to Malibu for the summer to find his cool hometown vibe corrupted.

programme.title: Kingpin
programme.desc: A star bowler whose career was prematurely "cut off" hopes to ride a new prodigy to success and riches.

programme.title: The Last Black Man in San Francisco
programme.desc: Jimmie & his best friend Mont try to reclaim the home built by Jimmie's grandfather, launching them on a poignant odyssey that connects them to their past, even as it tests their friendship & sense of belonging in the place they call home.

programme.title: Harlem Nights
programme.desc: In the waning days of Prohibition, Sugar Ray and his adopted son, Quick, run a speakeasy called Club Sugar Ray. Gangster Bugsy Calhoune pays corrupt cop Phil Cantone to close Club Sugar Ray down.

programme.title: Devotion
programme.desc: Jonathan Majors (Creed III) and Glen Powell (Top Gun: Maverick) star in the epic and inspirational true story of two elite US fighter pilots during the Korean War. Their heroic sacrifices would ultimately make them the Navy's most celebrated wingmen.

programme.title: The Great Christmas Light Fight
programme.desc: Showcasing the most spectacular and over-the-top Christmas displays in America.

programme.title: The Great Christmas Light Fight

programme.title: Father Goose
programme.desc: Cary Grant stars in one of his funniest roles as a boozy beachcomber sitting out WWII in peace - until the Allies recruit him to be a lookout on the South Pacific isle.

programme.title: Operation Petticoat
programme.desc: A submarine captain and his supply officer are determined to get their dry-dock sub back into WWII action. However, a bevy of nurses comes aboard, causing hijinks in the hot pink sub.

programme.title: Indiscreet
programme.desc: Cary Grant is the suave American diplomat who pretends to be married in order to preserve his bachelor status. Ingrid Bergman is the glamorous leading lady of the London stage who has no scruples about having an affair with a married man.

programme.title: XXX
programme.desc: Xander Cage is a notorious underground thrill-seeker deemed untouchable by the law. But when NSA Agent Gibbsons convinces Cage to infiltrate a ruthless Russian crime ring, this new breed of secret agent takes down the enemies of justice with a vengeance.

programme.title: Top Gun
programme.desc: Tom Cruise is superb as Maverick Mitchell, a young flyer who's out to become the best. And Kelly McGillis plays the instructor who teaches Maverick a few things you can't learn in a classroom.

programme.title: Top Gun: Maverick
programme.desc: Pete "Maverick" Mitchell keeps pushing the envelope after years of service as one of the Navy's top aviators. He must soon confront the past while training a new squad of graduates for a dangerous mission that demands the ultimate sacrifice.

programme.title: World War Z
programme.desc: World War Z is the fast-paced, pulse-pounding epic of the potential last days of the human race. Former United Nations employee Gerry Lane (Brad Pitt) is called in to help stop the pandemic that has spread around the world.

programme.title: Rise: Blood Hunter
programme.desc: Horror starring Lucy Liu. When she is turned into a vampire by a gang of the walking undead, journalist Sadie Blake embarks on a mission to take them down. That is, if she can control her own blood-thirst in the meantime…

programme.title: Overlord
programme.desc: Nothing can prepare you for the mind-blowing mayhem that is Overlord. Mega producer J.J. Abrams creates an insanely twisted thrill ride about a team of American troops who come face-to-face with Nazi super-soldiers unlike the world has ever seen.

programme.title: Gemini Man
programme.desc: Will Smith stars in the nonstop action thrill-ride from Academy Award®-winning director Ang Lee. Retired hitman (Smith) is forced on the run and finds himself hunted by his ultimate adversary - a younger clone of himself.

programme.title: After Earth
programme.desc: A crash landing leaves Kitai Raige (Jaden Smith) and his legendary father Cypher (Will Smith) stranded on Earth, 1,000 years after cataclysmic events forced humanity’s escape.

programme.title: Colombiana
programme.desc: Zoe Saldaña plays a young woman out to get revenge on the mobster responsible for her parents' deaths. Produced by Luc Besson and Ariel Zeitoun.

programme.title: Wing Chun
programme.desc: Wing Chun, a talented martial artist, decides to fight against horse thieves in the village to receive respect from the villagers.

programme.title: Tai Chi Master [English Subtitled]
programme.desc: Two friends, ex Shaolin monks, part ways as they brush with the ongoing rebellion against the government. The ambitious one rises up to be a powerful military commander, while his betrayed friend resorts to learn the calm ways of Tai Chi.

programme.title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
programme.desc: When an interdimensional rupture unravels reality, an unlikely hero (Michelle Yeoh) must channel her newfound powers to fight bizarre and bewildering dangers from the multiverse as the fate of everything hangs in the balance.

programme.title: Jackass Number Two
programme.desc: Prepare yourself for fits of uncontrollable laughter and waves of nausea as the guys launch their battered bodies into an onslaught of absurd situations.

programme.title: Jackass 2.5
programme.desc: You'll laugh till it hurts as Johnny Knoxville and the guys take you behind the scenes with Jackass 2.5, talking about this excess of never-before-seen stunts in hilarious new interviews.

programme.title: Jackass 3
programme.desc: The jackass guys are back, so brace yourself for unbelievable and totally explicit stunts from the idiots you've come to know and love from a safe and sanitary distance!

programme.title: Jackass 3.5
programme.desc: The boys of Jackass are at it again with an all-new movie loaded with outrageous, idiotic stunts you shouldn't try at home. You won't want to miss this big time batch of pranks, stupidity and mayhem from your favorite jackasses.

programme.title: 50 First Dates
programme.desc: A playboy tries to win over the girl of his dreams when he discovers she has no short-term memory.

programme.title: How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days
programme.desc: A "How to..." columnist agrees to write a first-hand account about what it takes to drive a man out of your life... in exactly 10 days.

programme.title: Just Like Heaven
programme.desc: He's convinced she's a spirit. She's convinced she's still alive. As they search for the truth of Elizabeth's past, their relationship changes from resentment to romance.

programme.title: Collateral
programme.desc: Vincent is a cool, calculating contract killer at the top of his game. Max is a cabbie with big dreams and no results. On this fateful night, Max has to transport Vincent on his next job - one night, five stops, five hits and a getaway.

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: A new technologically-superior Soviet nuclear sub is heading for the U.S. coast; however, one CIA analyst thinks the captain will defect the submarine, and he only has hours to prove it.

programme.title: Patriot Games
programme.desc: Jack Ryan is caught in the middle of a terrorist attack. Ryan helps to thwart Holmes’ assailants and becomes a local hero. But Ryan’s act marks him as a target. Now he must return to action to save his family.

programme.title: Capote
programme.desc: In 1959, Truman Capote, learns about the horrific and senseless murder of a family of four in Kansas. As he digs deeper into the story, he is inspired to expand the project into what would be his greatest work, In Cold Blood.

programme.title: Doubt
programme.desc: A mesmerizing, suspense-filled drama elevated by four riveting Oscar-nominated performances from Meryl Streep, Philip Seymour Hoffman, Amy Adams, and Viola Davis, DOUBT will have you pinned to the edge of your seat.

programme.title: The Master (2012)
programme.desc: Haunted by his past, WW-II veteran and drifter Freddie Quell (Joaquin Phoenix) crosses paths with a mysterious movement led by The Master (Phillip Seymour Hoffman) and his wife (Amy Adams).

programme.title: True Grit (2010)
programme.desc: True Grit is a powerful story of vengeance and valor set in an unforgiving and unpredictable frontier where justice is simple and mercy is rare.

programme.title: Lawless
programme.desc: Shia LaBeouf, Tom Hardy, and Jessica Chastain star in this adaptation of 'The Wettest County in the World.' A bootlegging gang make a run for the American Dream during Prohibition.

programme.title: Brimstone
programme.desc: A triumphant thriller set in the menacing inferno of the old American West, Brimstone tells the story of Liz, a genuine survivor who is hunted by a vengeful Preacher for a crime she didn’t commit.

programme.title: Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen
programme.desc: The battle for Earth continues when college-bound Sam Witwicky learns the truth about the ancient origins of the Transformers and must join in their continued battle against the Decepticons.

programme.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
programme.desc: A mysterious event from Earth's past threatens to ignite a war so big that the Transformers alone will not be able to save the planet. Sam Witwicky and the Autobots must fight against the darkness to defend our world from the Decepticons.

programme.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay comes the best 'Transformers' ever! With humanity facing extinction from a terrifying new threat, it's up to the Autobots to save Earth. They'll need new allies, including inventor Cade (Mark Wahlberg) and the Dinobots!

programme.title: Flatliners
programme.desc: Are you afraid to die? Kiefer Sutherland isn't. He's an ambitious, charismatic medical student who persuades classmates Julia Roberts and Kevin Bacon to take part in a reckless experiment. Rated: R

programme.title: In Too Deep
programme.desc: Officer Cole is assigned to infiltrate the syndicate of God, a deadly crime lord. But as Cole sinks deeper into God's crew, he begins to get in over his head, until the line that separates his true identity from his street persona begins to disappear.

programme.title: Driven
programme.desc: Talented rookie race-car driver Jimmy Bly (Kip Pardue) has started losing his focus and begins to slip in the race rankings. It's no wonder, with the immense pressure being shoveled on him by his overly ambitious promoter brother.

programme.title: Clerks
programme.desc: The legendary indie film that launched the career of Kevin Smith and won over audiences with its raw energy, outrageous comedy, and a hip soundtrack. CLERKS features razor-sharp wit and the debut of pop-culture icons Jay and Silent Bob.

programme.title: Hackers
programme.desc: A neophyte hacker becomes the target of the FBI after he unknowingly taps into a high-tech embezzling scheme which could cause a horrific environmental disaster in this suspenseful drama.

programme.title: Evolution
programme.desc: A firefighting cadet, two college professors, and a geeky-but-sexy government scientist work against an alien organism that has been rapidly evolving ever since its arrival on Earth inside a meteor.

programme.title: The Blackcoat's Daughter
programme.desc: Two terrified girls (Emma Roberts, Kiernan Shipka) must battle a mysterious evil force when they get left behind at their boarding school over winter break in this chilling and suspenseful horror film.

programme.title: The Innkeepers
programme.desc: After over one hundred years of service, The Yankee Pedlar Inn is shutting its doors for good. The last remaining employees - Claire and Luke - are determined to uncover proof of what many believe to be one of New England's most haunted hotels.

programme.title: The Reading
programme.desc: After a deadly home invasion, Emma (Mo'Nique Hicks) copes by writing a book, but when a young psychic and her team perform a reading in her home, a new terror is unleashed.

programme.title: First Blood
programme.desc: A soft-spoken Vietnam vet drifts into a small town looking for no trouble, but finds it in the form of a psychotic local sheriff who finds pleasure in hating him for no reason.

programme.title: Rambo: First Blood Part II
programme.desc: John Rambo is sent on assignment back to Southeast Asia to uncover evidence of still missing POWs, and ends up with his hands full when he comes up against Vietnamese soldiers still guarding the camps.

programme.title: Rambo III
programme.desc: Rambo refuses to join his friend and former mentor, Colonel Trautman, on a mission to Afghanistan. The mission fails and Trautman is captured by Russian troops. Now Rambo must infiltrate the Russian fortress to save his only friend.

programme.title: Super 8
programme.desc: In the summer of 1979, a group of friends in a small Ohio town witness a catastrophic train crash while making a Super 8 movie and soon suspect that it was not an accident.

programme.title: Harriet the Spy
programme.desc: Harriet M. Welsch is probably the world’s most accomplished 11-year-old spy. Harriet dreams of being a writer, and her nanny and best friend, Golly, told her to start by writing down everything she sees.

programme.title: Lemony Snicket's A Series of Unfortunate Events
programme.desc: A thrilling misadventure involving three ingenious orphans and a villainous actor named Count Olaf (Jim Carrey) who wants their enormous fortune.

programme.title: Snatch
programme.desc: A diamond heist gone haywire launches gangsters, bookies, and a dog on a rollicking ride through the rugged world of bare-knuckle boxing in search of the missing stone. Critically acclaimed comedy from Guy Ritchie.

programme.title: Cop Land
programme.desc: Director James Mangold (FORD vs FERRARI) extends his crime thriller classic that brings together a powerhouse cast, including Robert De Niro, Sylvester Stallone, Ray Liotta, and Harvey Keitel.

programme.title: Witness
programme.desc: When a young Amish woman and her son get caught up in the murder of an undercover narcotic's agent, their saviour turns out to be hardened Philadelphia detective John Book.

programme.title: Overlord
programme.desc: Nothing can prepare you for the mind-blowing mayhem that is Overlord. Mega producer J.J. Abrams creates an insanely twisted thrill ride about a team of American troops who come face-to-face with Nazi super-soldiers unlike the world has ever seen.

programme.title: Remember
programme.desc: Everything is not what it seems in this riveting revenge thriller, where a relentless man will stop at nothing to find and kill the Nazi officer who murdered his family 70 years earlier in WWII.

programme.title: The Boys From Brazil
programme.desc: A Nazi hunter in Paraguay discovers a sinister and bizarre plot to rekindle the Third Reich.

programme.title: The Pride of the Yankees
programme.desc: The story of the life and career of famed baseball player Lou Gehrig.

programme.title: The High and the Mighty
programme.desc: John Wayne plays Dan Roman, a veteran pilot haunted by a tragic past. Now relegated to second-incommand cockpit assignments, he finds himself scheduled on a routine Honolulu-to-San Francisco flight – one that takes a terrifying turn.

programme.title: Colombiana
programme.desc: Zoe Saldaña plays a young woman out to get revenge on the mobster responsible for her parents' deaths. Produced by Luc Besson and Ariel Zeitoun.

programme.title: London Has Fallen
programme.desc: In London for the Prime Minister's funeral, Mike Banning is caught up in a plot to assassinate all the attending world leaders.

programme.title: 13 Hours: The Secret Soldiers of Benghazi
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay, 13 HOURS is the gripping true story of six elite ex-military operators assigned to protect the CIA who fought back against overwhelming odds when terrorists attacked a U.S. diplomatic compound on September 11, 2012.

programme.title: Pandorum
programme.desc: Two crew members wake up on an abandoned spacecraft without knowing who they are, how long they've been asleep, or their mission. Soon after, they discover they're not alone, and the situation is more horrifying than they ever could have imagined.

programme.title: World War Z
programme.desc: World War Z is the fast-paced, pulse-pounding epic of the potential last days of the human race. Former United Nations employee Gerry Lane (Brad Pitt) is called in to help stop the pandemic that has spread around the world.

programme.title: Bug
programme.desc: A paranoid, unhinged war veteran who sees insects everywhere holes up with a lonely woman in a spooky Oklahoma motel room.

programme.title: Traitor
programme.desc: When straight arrow FBI agent Roy Clayton (Guy Pearce of MOMENTO) heads up the investigation into a dangerous international conspiracy, all clues seem to lead back to former U.S. Special Operations officer, Samir Horn (Don Cheadle of CRASH).

programme.title: Gemini Man
programme.desc: Will Smith stars in the nonstop action thrill-ride from Academy Award®-winning director Ang Lee. Retired hitman (Smith) is forced on the run and finds himself hunted by his ultimate adversary - a younger clone of himself.

programme.title: Drop Zone
programme.desc: Wesley Snipes free-falls into the daredevil world of sky-diving to track down a cadre of techno terrorists in Drop Zone, a chute-to-thrill adventure co-starring Gary Busey, Yancy Butler, Michael Jeter and more.

programme.title: Reign Of Assassins
programme.desc: Elusive assassin Drizzle transforms herself into modest shop owner Zeng Jing (Michelle Yeoh) in order to transport the remains of an exalted Buddhist monk to their eternal resting place, but finds her mission unexpectedly complicated.

programme.title: Master Z: Ip Man Legacy
programme.desc: Legendary action director Yuen Woo Ping draws on a stellar cast (Michelle Yeoh, Dave Bautista, Tony Jaa, and Max Zhang) to create a hard-hitting martial arts blast worthy of its place in the celebrated IP MAN universe.

programme.title: Ong Bak
programme.desc: Raised by monks who taught him the Thai martial art of muay thai, Ting (Tony Jaa) is sent to Bangkok to retrieve the stolen head of the town's statue of the Buddha.

programme.title: Jackass: The Movie
programme.desc: All the jackasses you love from the MTV series are back performing stunts no one would let them pull on television.

programme.title: Jackass Number Two
programme.desc: Prepare yourself for fits of uncontrollable laughter and waves of nausea as the guys launch their battered bodies into an onslaught of absurd situations.

programme.title: Jackass 2.5
programme.desc: You'll laugh till it hurts as Johnny Knoxville and the guys take you behind the scenes with Jackass 2.5, talking about this excess of never-before-seen stunts in hilarious new interviews.

programme.title: Julie & Julia
programme.desc: Julie & Julia, tells the true stories of how Julia Child's life and cookbook inspired fledgling writer Julie Powell to whip up 524 recipes in 365 days and introduce a new generation to the magic of French cooking.

programme.title: It Had To Be You
programme.desc: Surprised by a sudden proposal and subsequent ultimatum from her boyfriend, Sonia embarks on a bumpy, raunchy journey of self-discovery.

programme.title: How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days
programme.desc: A "How to..." columnist agrees to write a first-hand account about what it takes to drive a man out of your life... in exactly 10 days.

programme.title: Jack Ryan: Shadow Recruit
programme.desc: Jack Ryan must quickly evolve from soldier to analyst to full-fledged operative to stop a devastating terrorist plot against the United States.

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: A new technologically-superior Soviet nuclear sub is heading for the U.S. coast; however, one CIA analyst thinks the captain will defect the submarine, and he only has hours to prove it.

programme.title: A Most Wanted Man
programme.desc: Phillip Seymour Hoffman stars in this action-thriller from spymaster John Le Carre. German and U.S. intelligence agencies race to uncover the identity of a mysterious man.

programme.title: American Buffalo
programme.desc: A pair of crooks and their young intern plot the theft of a valuable Buffalo-head nickel. Most of the story takes place within the junky confines of Don Dubrow's second-hand store.

programme.title: Eddie and the Cruisers
programme.desc: A reporter begins tracking down rumors of an unreleased album by a rock band whose charismatic leader disappeared after an accident and was presumed dead years before.

programme.title: Billy the Kid
programme.desc: When a bounty hunter kills a member of an outlaw gang, all Hell breaks loose in this shoot-‘em-up tale of gun smoke and justice in the Old West.

programme.title: True Grit (2010)
programme.desc: True Grit is a powerful story of vengeance and valor set in an unforgiving and unpredictable frontier where justice is simple and mercy is rare.

programme.title: Damsel
programme.desc: A businessman travels West to join his fiancée in the mountains.

programme.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay comes the best 'Transformers' ever! With humanity facing extinction from a terrifying new threat, it's up to the Autobots to save Earth. They'll need new allies, including inventor Cade (Mark Wahlberg) and the Dinobots!

programme.title: Bumblebee
programme.desc: On a mission to protect Earth, the battle-scarred and broken Bumblebee is found and repaired by a teenager named Charlie. They must work together to save the planet from the evil Decepticons in this action-packed adventure for the whole family.

programme.title: Transformers: Rise of the Beasts
programme.desc: Optimus Prime and the Autobots take on their biggest challenge yet. When a new threat capable of destroying the entire planet emerges, they must team up with the powerful Transformers faction, the Maximals, to save Earth.

programme.title: The Green Knight
programme.desc: An epic fantasy adventure based on the timeless Arthurian legend, The Green Knight tells the story of Sir Gawain, King Arthur's reckless and headstrong nephew, who embarks on a daring quest to confront the eponymous Green Knight.

programme.title: Hercules (2014)
programme.desc: The most towering myth of all time meets up with the mission of a real man in this action-adventure thriller that reveals the famed symbol of courage as he’s never been seen before: finding the hero’s heart that beats beneath his colossal image.

programme.title: The Boondock Saints
programme.desc: Two Irish Catholic brothers become vigilantes and wipe out Boston's criminal underworld in the name of God.

programme.title: Bio-Dome
programme.desc: In this outrageous Comedy, five brave scientists are forced to face life forms more perplexing, more terrifying, more annoying than anything they've ever encountered: Pauly Shore and Stephen Baldwin.

programme.title: Clerks
programme.desc: The legendary indie film that launched the career of Kevin Smith and won over audiences with its raw energy, outrageous comedy, and a hip soundtrack. CLERKS features razor-sharp wit and the debut of pop-culture icons Jay and Silent Bob.

programme.title: Evolution
programme.desc: A firefighting cadet, two college professors, and a geeky-but-sexy government scientist work against an alien organism that has been rapidly evolving ever since its arrival on Earth inside a meteor.

programme.title: Hundreds of Beavers
programme.desc: A drunken applejack salesman must go from zero to hero and become North America's greatest fur trapper by defeating Hundreds of Beavers.

programme.title: Mother's Day (2012)
programme.desc: Rebecca DeMornay is terrifying in this brutal gorefest. When her sons break into a home and take the owners hostage, she teaches them what real torture is all about. Costars Shawn Ashmore.

programme.title: While She Was Out
programme.desc: Della (Academy-Award®-winner Kim Basinger), a suburban housewife, is hell-bent on survival as she is mercilessly stalked by a group of teenage thugs led by a manipulative psychopath (Luke Haas of WITNESS).

programme.title: My Heart Can't Beat Unless You Tell It To
programme.desc: Dwight and his sister Jessie reach a crossroads over what to do about their younger brother Thomas, a sickly child with a mysterious affliction.

programme.title: Platoon
programme.desc: The film probes the psyche of the young soldiers who fought in Vietnam. Their camaraderie, their struggle for survival amid terrifying violence and madness of combat.

programme.title: Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: The summer of 1964... Two FBI agents--one a tight-jawed, by-the-book type, the other an experienced Southern lawman who knows how to handle people--head the government's investigation into the disappearance of three civil rights activists in Mississippi.

programme.title: First Blood
programme.desc: A soft-spoken Vietnam vet drifts into a small town looking for no trouble, but finds it in the form of a psychotic local sheriff who finds pleasure in hating him for no reason.

programme.title: Hugo
programme.desc: Set in 1930s Paris, an orphan who lives in the walls of a train station is wrapped up in a mystery involving his late father and an automaton.

programme.title: Harriet the Spy
programme.desc: Harriet M. Welsch is probably the world’s most accomplished 11-year-old spy. Harriet dreams of being a writer, and her nanny and best friend, Golly, told her to start by writing down everything she sees.

programme.title: Lemony Snicket's A Series of Unfortunate Events
programme.desc: A thrilling misadventure involving three ingenious orphans and a villainous actor named Count Olaf (Jim Carrey) who wants their enormous fortune.

programme.title: The Italian Job (2003)
programme.desc: The plan was flawless. The execution was perfect. Charlie Croker pulled off the crime of a lifetime. The one thing that he didn't plan on was being double-crossed.

programme.title: The Untouchables
programme.desc: This confrontation between good and evil stars Kevin Costner as federal agent Eliot Ness, Robert De Niro as gangland kingpin Al Capone, and Sean Connery as Malone, the cop who teaches Ness how to beat the mob: shoot fast and shoot first.

programme.title: Cop Land
programme.desc: Director James Mangold (FORD vs FERRARI) extends his crime thriller classic that brings together a powerhouse cast, including Robert De Niro, Sylvester Stallone, Ray Liotta, and Harvey Keitel.

programme.title: This Must Be The Place
programme.desc: Cheyenne (Sean Penn), a retired rock star living off his royalties in Dublin, returns to New York City to find the Nazi responsible for humiliating his recently deceased father during WWII.

programme.title: Overlord
programme.desc: Nothing can prepare you for the mind-blowing mayhem that is Overlord. Mega producer J.J. Abrams creates an insanely twisted thrill ride about a team of American troops who come face-to-face with Nazi super-soldiers unlike the world has ever seen.

programme.title: Bullet In The Head
programme.desc: When three close friends escape from Hong Kong to war-time Saigon to start a criminal's life, they all go through a harrowing experience which totally shatters their lives and their friendship forever.

programme.title: Sliding Doors
programme.desc: The split-second moments that can take a life down one path instead of another form the tantalizing 'what if?' in this delightful romantic comedy starring Gwyneth Paltrow.

programme.title: Next Stop Wonderland
programme.desc: A young nurse is forced back into the dating scene by her mother after a bad break up.

programme.title: Benny & Joon
programme.desc: Johnny Depp and Mary Stuart Masterson star in this quirky romantic Drama about two misfits who Comedye together as a result of an unusual poker game. Aidan Quinn and Julianne Moore co-star.

programme.title: Everything You Always Wanted to Know About Sex * But Were Afraid to Ask
programme.desc: Woody Allen heads up an amazing cast including Gene Wilder, Tony Randall and Lynn Redgrave, in several hysterical vignettes that spoof the unorthodox joys of sex.

programme.title: Manhattan
programme.desc: Woody Allen, Diane Keaton, Meryl Streep and Mariel Hemingway star in Woody Allen's extraordinary and funny film that explores the embattled life and loves of a successful New York comedy writer.

programme.title: Lifeguard
programme.desc: A fifteen-year high school reunion gets an aging lifeguard thinking about becoming a salesman in this romantic drama starring Sam Elliott, Anne Archer and Kathleen Quinlan.

programme.title: Sin City: A Dame To Kill For
programme.desc: Some of Sin City's most hard-boiled citizens cross paths with a few of its more reviled inhabitants.

programme.title: The Spirit

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Al Gore visita South Park e intenta convencer a Stan, Kyle, Cartman y Kenny para salir a cazar al peligroso hombre-oso-cerdo. Al ayudarlo, los chicos se quedan atrapados en una cueva y mientras tratan de salir, Cartman descubre un tesoro.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Jimmy y Timmy entrenan para participar en las Olimpiadas Especiales y Jimmy acepta esteroides que le ofrece Nathan. Mientras, Cartman se disfraza para convencer a un comité calificado de que él es discapacitado y así ganar el premio.

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La última de las pruebas científicas revela que algunos de los chicos de South Park tiene un problema de adicción al sexo.

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr Bean quiere adoptar una mascota, pero su alojamiento tiene una política de no mascotas. Al ingresar con su nuevo amigo, un loro, Bean deberá pasar delante de su casera y su gato tuerto descubriendo que no es una tarea fácil.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Es un hermoso día en la playa y Mr. Bean decide ir a broncearse. ¿Qué podría arruinar este perfecto día? La respuesta es: el clima británico. Se encuentra a si mismo persiguiendo un ilusorio rayo de sol por todo el pueblo.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr Bean se olvida del cumpleaños de su fiel amigo Teddy. La única que se acordó es la novia de Bean, Irma Gobb. Ahora Mr Bean debe decidir cual será el regalo perfecto para Teddy.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: El juego de croquet de Mr Wicket es interrumpido por un topo ofensivo. Ella le ordena a Bean sacarlo del jardín.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr. Bean es atormentado por los fuertes sonidos de obras viales en su calle, y hace todo lo posible para hacerle frente. Intenta de todas maneras frenar el desagradable sonido pero todo es más complicado de lo que parece.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Al Sr. Bean no le gusta nada más que relajarse en su viejo sofá con una buena comida y su programa de tv favorito. Desafortunadamente, una dolorosa explosión de resortes lo obliga a comprar un sofá nuevo. En el proceso pierde el control remoto.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr. Bean va en búsqueda del tesoro después de encontrar un mapa en el ático de la señora Wicket. La cacería comienza llena de pistas engañosas y no será nada fácil.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr Bean busca un nuevo hogar cuando la señora Wicket lo ha echado. Casi llorando, anhela la acogedora familiaridad de su antiguo hogar. Un espantapájaros y un par de dientes postizos vienen a su rescate.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Luego de ver una antigua foto de su niñez, Mr. Bean decide irse de campamento. Sin embargo el viaje desde la tienda hasta el campo se encuentra plagado de dificultades. Nada detendrá a Bean y a Teddy de disfrutar de las estrellas en el cielo nocturno.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Luego de que su modelo de avión fuera derribado por el de su pequeño rival, Mr. Bean construye uno nuevo para competir y tener su venganza. Con Teddy como piloto, la carrera comienza en el espacio aéreo de Londres.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr. Beans rompe su taza de té favorita, y se dirige a un lugar especial para encontrar otra taza de ese tipo. Allí luchará contra un pequeño canino que se ha robado a Teddy.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Hurgando en un viejo baúl en el ático de Mrs Wicket, Mr Bean nos transporta a su juventud. Allí nos develará cuando conoció a su fiel amigo Teddy y cuando aprendió a manejar su mini cooper. Su pasado fue lo que lo convirtió en el hombre que es ahora.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Heidi: Preparando un espectáculo

programme.title: Heidi: En el parque

programme.title: Heidi: Clara se pone de pie

programme.title: Heidi: Cabras en la ciudad
programme.desc: Heidi y Clara dan una vuelta de nuevo por el parque, descubren que el parque hay cabras, pero la más bebé esta enferma. Heidi se la lleva a casa para curarla pero debe apresurarse antes de que regrese la señorita Rottenmeier.

programme.title: Heidi: La renuncia

programme.title: Heidi: Un árbol como refugio

programme.title: Heidi: El fantasma

programme.title: Heidi: La carta

programme.title: Heidi: De regreso en Dörfli
programme.desc: Heidi toma el tren de vuelta a las montañas, el abuelo no recibe la carta y emprende un viaje a Mayenfeld, Heidi hará todo lo posible para llegar con su abuelo y pedirle que regrese a las montañas.

programme.title: Heidi: Una nueva cabra en el rebaño

programme.title: Naruto: Muy tarde para ayudar

programme.title: Naruto: La muerte de Naruto

programme.title: Naruto: Cuando el tiempo se detuvo

programme.title: Naruto: Cuando Las Garzas Extendieron Sus Alas

programme.title: Naruto: ¡Mezcla, bátelo, que hierva, que se caliente la olla de cobre!

programme.title: Naruto: Remembranza: La Página Perdida

programme.title: Naruto: La Puerta Cerrada

programme.title: Naruto: Infiltración: ¡La trampa preparada!
programme.desc: Tan pronto como se despierta, Anko comienza a recordar la Isla Demonio, un lugar que visitó hace tiempo junto con su antiguo sensei, Orochimaru. Anko revela la verdad acerca de las desapariciones y el secreto del cuerpo de Isaribi.

programme.title: Naruto: Desesperación: Un corazón roto
programme.desc: Amachi y su grupo lanzan su ataque sobre el barco del gobierno. Naruto y los demás escapan de la Isla Demonio, pero lo primero que ven es la flota de la Tierra del Mar al borde de la aniquilación.

programme.title: One Piece - Arabasta Saga

programme.title: One Piece - Arabasta Saga

programme.title: One Piece - Arabasta Saga

programme.title: One Piece - Arabasta Saga

programme.title: Kamen Rider 555 - Faiz
programme.desc: Takumi y Masato tienen dificultades cuando se enfrentan a Takuma y Saeko, quienes usan sus cinturones. Masato es secuestrado por ellos, pero Takumi es salvado por Keitaro y Mari cuando arrojan la camioneta sobre Takuma y Saeko.

programme.title: Kamen Rider 555 - Faiz
programme.desc: Los almuerzos tranquilos en la casa de Keitaro cambiaron repentinamente cuando la conversación en la mesa giró hacia el padre de Masato.

programme.title: Kamen Rider 555 - Faiz
programme.desc: Los estudiantes del Curso Ryusei luchan entre ellos, donde cada uno quiere tener en sus manos el gran poder que tiene el Delta Gear. Takumi, que observa la situación, intenta forzar a Mari a salir de este círculo que involucra a todos en el Curso Ryusei.

programme.title: Kamen Rider 555 - Faiz
programme.desc: Mari, Masato, Rina y Takumi se sienten decepcionados al saber que Sawada, uno de los otros estudiantes del Curso Ryusei, se ha convertido en Orphenoc.

programme.title: Kamen Rider 555 - Faiz
programme.desc: Saya Kimura, una de las estudiantes del Curso Ryusei, fue asesinada y poco después se descubrió que tenía el Delta Gear con ella. Mari está muy apenada por esto, y Masato intenta consolarla, mientras que Takumi Inui se queda sin palabras.

programme.title: Kamen Rider 555 - Faiz
programme.desc: Finalmente, Takumi y Yuji descubren cada uno sus respectivas identidades, y esto ocurre en medio de un ataque de Kitazaki (Dragon Orphenoc), transformado en Kamen Rider Delta.

programme.title: Kamen Rider 555 - Faiz
programme.desc: Yuji y Takumi continúan sospechando de las acciones y motivos del otro, pero ni siquiera se dan cuenta de que están a punto de caer en un nuevo marco ideado por Masato.

programme.title: Kamen Rider 555 - Faiz
programme.desc: Mari se niega a seguir el consejo de Masato sobre no confiar en Sawada. Sin embargo, Takumi le dice a Masato que quiere apostar por las palabras de Mari.

programme.title: Kamen Rider 555 - Faiz

programme.title: iCarly: El amor perdido de Lewbert

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT
programme.desc: Se acerca el cumpleaños número 81 del Abuelo, el cumpleaños donde todos los hombres de la familia mueren. / Helga y Miriam tienen un viaje en auto no muy agradable.

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT
programme.desc: Lila comienza a gustarle Arnold / Luego que el Tormenta Malva de Eugene y el Vengador Oscuro de Arnold, Sid y Stinky son destruidos en las preliminares del torneo Grand Prix, deciden combinarlos en un sólo auto para las finales

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT
programme.desc: Arnold y Helga se escapan de sus respectivas familias ya que desean pasar un día de acción de gracias normal, cosa que ninguna de las familias tiene.

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT
programme.desc: Arnold, cansado que Helga siempre se burle de él en la escuela, le pide consejo al Abuelo acerca de lo que debe hacer. / Arnold es el encargado del entretenimiento en el baile anual de la escuela y le pide a Dino Spumoni que cante en él.

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT
programme.desc: Helga tiene su propio número de entretenimiento, hacer imitaciones bastante buenas de los demás. / Los chicos se quedan atrapados en la escuela cuando una tormenta inunda las calles.

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT
programme.desc: La clase del Señor Simmons hará la obra anual de la escuela, este año él eligió la obra Romeo y Julieta, y cuando Helga se entera que Arnold hará a Romeo, ella hará hasta lo imposible por quedarse con el papel de Julieta.

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT
programme.desc: Cuando Big Bob llama a Arnold huérfano en el fin de semana de los padres, Arnold le pregunta al Abuelo qué pasó realmente con sus padres.

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT
programme.desc: Arnold pierde las invitaciones de la fiesta de cumpleaños de Eugene y nadie asiste, pero luego que Arnold le organiza una segunda fiesta y también fracasa. / Stinky decide probar suerte con la jardinería.

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT
programme.desc: Helga gana una cena para cuatro personas y decide llevar a Phoebe para que ella lleve a Gerald y a su mejor amigo. / Phoebe es promovida al sexto grado, y Helga tiene problemas buscando una compañera.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Con la ayuda de Zuko, Katara decide enfrentar al soldado de la Nación del Fuego responsable de la muerte de su madre, pero ¿qué hará cuando lo encuentre?

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Los chicos van a la Isla Ember a ver una obra de teatro sobre sí mismos y todas sus aventuras pasadas. Sin embargo, no quedan contentos con la producción.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Los chicos obtienen nueva información sobre el plan maestro del Señor del Fuego Ozai y deciden atacar antes de lo planeado, pero ¿estará listo Aang?

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Mientras que el Señor del Fuego Ozai comienza su plan maestro, el grupo trata de detenerlo. Mientras tanto, Aang recibe consejos de los anteriores Avatar.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: El grupo se divide para poner fin a la guerra.Zuko y Katara se dirigen a la Nación del Fuego para enfrentarse a Azula. Suki,Sokka y Toph intentan detener al ejército aéreo y Aang se prepara para enfrentarse al Señor del Fuego.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang desata toda la potencia de su largamente inactivo Estado Avatar para poder luchar contra el Señor del Fuego, pero ¿podrá acabar con su reino sin morir en el intento? La útlima batalla termina aquí.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Los hermanos Katara y Sokka, de la Tribu del Agua, descubren a un niño congelado en un iceberg. Katara se pregunta si podrá ser el Avatar por el cual el mundo estuvo esperando por cientos de años.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: El príncipe Zuko, joven maestro fuego, cuya misión es capturar al Avatar, le sigue la huella a Aang hacia la tribu del Agua del Sur, donde viven Katara y Sokka.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang está ansioso por llevar a Sokka y Katara al Templo del Aire del Sur, donde él creció, pero descubre que el templo ya no es como lo recordaba.

programme.title: Naruto: Batalla En El Mar: ¡El Poder Liberado!
programme.desc: El ninja de la Aldea de la hoja y Amachi combaten en el mar. Con la ayuda de Naruto, Amachi es derrotado, pero aparece un monstruo. Naruto invoca a Gamabunta para acabar con él.

programme.title: Naruto: ¡Inconcebible! Arte ninja célebre: ¡El Jutsu del dinero!
programme.desc: ¡Kunijiro visita a Tsunade y decide que Naruto le muestre a su muchacho la vida de un ninja durante un día!

programme.title: Naruto: ¡A La caza del tesoro!
programme.desc: El amigo de Tsunade, Agari Kaisen, pide a Naruto, Kiba y Hinata que busquen un tesoro enterrado. Pensando que será una tarea fácil, ya que disponen de un mapa, Tsunade los amenaza con enviarlos de vuelta a la Academia Ninja si no lo consiguen.

programme.title: Naruto: Corriendo, esquivando y hasta en zig-zag: ¡Persigue o serás perseguido!

programme.title: Naruto: ¡Por favor, señor cartero!

programme.title: Naruto: ¡Confrontación! El niño con nombre de estrella
programme.desc: La Aldea de la Hoja recibe una misión de la Aldea Escondida entre las estrellas en la que deben proteger a una estrella. En realidad, la estrella es un meteorito que cayó hace 200 años y se dice que posee poderes misteriosos.

programme.title: Naruto: La canción de cuna de los recuerdos
programme.desc: Naruto y sus compañeros investigan el paradero de la estrella robada. El grupo sospecha que el culpable es un habitante de la Aldea de la Estrella, ya que el ninja que la robó usó una técnica, Kujaku, que pertenece a la aldea.

programme.title: Naruto: ¡Jutsu Escondido! El Precio Del Arte Ninja: Kujaku
programme.desc: Akahoshi, el ninja enmascarado que secuestró a Sumaru, pretende usar a Sumaru para descubrir quién es el misterioso ninja que robó la estrella.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! GX

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! GX

programme.title: Death Note

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Cuando dos adolescentes mayores se burlan de Kenan y Kel por ser demasiado jóvenes para entrar a una verdadera discoteca, los muchachos deciden hacer su propia discoteca... ¡en Rigby's!.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Mientras están viendo un programa de investigación de delitos, Kenan y Kel se convencen de que el padre de Kenan es un ladrón conocido como el “Bandido Diamante”, e intentan devolver lo que ellos creen que son los diamantes robados.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kel tiene un resfriado, y Kenan decide preparar un remedio casero, usando pollo, huevos, sardinas, malvaviscos y gaseosa de naranja. Para su sorpresa, Kel se cura y ahora Kenan tiene que acordarse de la receta, cuando su papá se enferma.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan salva la vida del presidente de los Estados Unidos y es invitado a la Casa Blanca, en donde Kel, accidentalmente, destruye una fotografía muy valiosa.

programme.title: Death Note

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: A pesar de que Mikami había escrito el nombre de todos los investigadores en el Death Note, ya había pasado un minuto y todos seguían vivos. Near obtiene el Death Note y todo es revelado.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: El brillante pero aburrido estudiante Light Yagami de repente se encuentra sosteniendo el poder de la vida y la muerte en sus manos, el Death Note. Cuando asesinatos empiezan a acumular, el detective L toma el caso y ¡una batalla de inteligencia comienza!

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Mientras los criminales del mundo continúan muriendo, L se reúne con representantes de varias naciones. Él solicita que un nuevo cuartel general de la fuerza especial sea creado en Japón bajo la dirección de no otro que Soichiro Yagami ¡El padre de Light!

programme.title: Death Note

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Light, conocido mundialmente como Kira, prueba el alcance de los poderes del Death Note matando a 6 convictos de diferentes maneras, así confirma que puede controlar las acciones de sus víctimas ¡antes de que mueran!

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Soichiro Yagami demanda una reunión en persona con L cuando se entera que él secretamente ha traído agentes del FBI a Japón, mientras tanto, Light ha encontrado una manera de sacar a los agentes del FBI ¡permanentemente del caso!

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Light se reúne con una mujer en el departamento de policía ya que tiene un mensaje importante para el cuerpo especial Kira, como hijo del investigador en jefe, Light escucha su historia y descubre que ella posee información que podría llevar a su arresto!

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Light usa el Death Note para tratar de deshacerse de la mujer que podría capturarlo, y se sorprende cuando no funciona. Ella le ha dado un nombre falso. Light solo tiene minutos para averiguar su nombre antes de contar su historia a la policía.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.desc: Disfruta de los mejores conciertos musicales las 24 horas del día. Enciende tus sentidos con Concert Channel en Pluto TV.

programme.title: Bâtiment B
programme.desc: Los pasillos del Bâtiment B son el lugar de encuentro de todos aquellos que componen el rap de hoy y de mañana.

programme.title: Echoes with Jehnny Beth
programme.desc: Formado en Belfast en 2019, Enola Gay es el resultado de la unión de cuatro músicos que abrazan con entusiasmo la tradición anglosajona, que combina la canción con la reivindicación, para transmitir su mensaje.

programme.title: Metronomy - Passengers: Paris Natural History Museum
programme.desc: Metronomy presenta su nuevo álbum, Small World, así como algunos de sus temas clásicos, desde la galería de paleontología del Museo Nacional de Historia Natural de Francia en París.

programme.title: The Prodigy: Live in Germany
programme.desc: Esta película concierto, filmada el 6 de junio de 2009 en Núremberg, Alemania, es una espectacular experiencia en vivo de principio a fin para todos los fans.

programme.title: Elektra
programme.desc: Elektra tras recuperarse de las mortales heridas sufridas en "Daredevil", se convierte en la más peligrosa asesina del mundo.

programme.title: Danny, el Perro
programme.desc: Un hombre esclavizado por la mafia desde la infancia y criado para comportarse como un perro de presa humano escapa de sus captores e intenta comenzar una nueva vida.

programme.title: Respeto
programme.desc: Lucas comienza un romance con Jasmine sin saber que antes anduvo con Jacob, uno de sus amigos. Tras sentirse traicionado, Jacob delata a Lucas con el hermanastro de Jasmine y sólo provoca la ira entre pandillas.

programme.title: Locura de Amor en las Vegas
programme.desc: Jack y Joy, dos extraños completamente diferentes, despiertan en Las Vegas y descubren que no solamente estuvieron de suerte, ¡sino que se casaron!

programme.title: The cobbler
programme.desc: Cuenta la historia de un zapatero que tiene la peculiar habilidad de asumir la vida de sus clientes a través de los zapatos que repara.

programme.title: Por Accidente para Siempre
programme.desc: Simon, el verdadero autor de las novelas románticas de 'Sally Carmichael', oculta su identidad para mantener su reputación.

programme.title: Hospital del Terror
programme.desc: Una fría noche de diciembre, un equipo de investigaciones paranormales ponen la mira en un sangriento sanatorio de Hillcrest para contestar a una vieja pregunta: ¿Hay vida después de la muerte?

programme.title: La Invocación
programme.desc: Akane es una maestra que escucha de sus alumnos el rumor de que hay imágenes de alguien suicidándose en Internet. Estas imágenes llevan a quienes también las ven a suicidarse.

programme.title: A Cure for Wellness
programme.desc: Un ejecutivo debe salvar a su jefe de un "centro de bienestar" que mantiene adictos a sus pacientes.

programme.title: La Estafa
programme.desc: Clifford Irving vende la biografía falsa de Howard Hughes a una editorial a principios de los años setenta, lo que provoca un frenesí fantástico en los medios.

programme.title: Fight Club
programme.desc: Un hombre deprimido conoce a un fabricante de jabones, y juntos forman un club de pelea clandestino que evoluciona en algo inesperado.

programme.title: Madame Bovary
programme.desc: Una joven de procedencia humilde se casa con un doctor de una pequeña ciudad. Atrapada en un matrimonio que no la satisface, busca consuelo teniendo relaciones extra conyugales que, además, la ayudan a medrar socialmente.

programme.title: THE PERFECT GAME
programme.desc: Basado en una historia real. En 1957, un grupo de niños pobres de Monterrey, México, conmocionó al mundo al ganar 13 juegos seguidos y la Serie Mundial de Pequeñas Ligas en el único juego perfecto jamás lanzado en el Campeonato.

programme.title: The Sentinel
programme.desc: Un agente es culpado injustamente por planear el asesinato del presidente.

programme.title: Recuerdos de una Infancia
programme.desc: Es el otoño de 1985. Las historias entrelazadas de tres amigos de quinto grado, Chris, Joe y Ted, se desarrollan en el paraíso suburbano de Palo Alto, mientras la amenaza de un león de montaña se cierne sobre la comunidad.

programme.title: L.A. Confidential
programme.desc: A medida que la corrupción crece en Los Ángeles de los años 50, tres policías, uno de ellos de carácter estricto, otro brutal y otro sórdido, investigan una serie de asesinatos.

programme.title: Un extraño en Sugarcreek
programme.desc: Rachel Troyer es una mujer policía en la pintoresca población de Sugarcreek. Con frecuencia visita a sus tías Amish, que la criaron cuando se quedó huérfana. Cuando un vagabundo aparece con su hijo de cinco años, las bondadosas tías insisten en acogerles.

programme.title: Diamante de ilusiones
programme.desc: Mickey Tussler, un lanzador autista, se une a un equipo de béisbol de ligas menores y tiene un profundo efecto en el equipo y en el mánager Arthur "Murph" Murphy en el transcurso de la temporada.

programme.title: Una prueba de fe
programme.desc: John y Alexa Taylor parecen tener la vida perfecta. Son la envidia de todos los padres de la ciudad. Su hijo Beau es la estrella del fútbol de la escuela y su hija Ravyn es la estudiante número uno.

programme.title: El Deseo de Charlie
programme.desc: Un veterano militar regresa a casa después de estar ausente por estrés postraumático. Con su nuevo perro, descubre en medio de la Navidad un nuevo propósito en su vida: ayudar a los exmilitares que necesitan ayuda

programme.title: La cabaña de Navidad
programme.desc: Mary se va de vacaciones a las montañas con su novio. De camino, encuentran a una niña que se había torcido el tobillo, y que casualmente es la hija de un antiguo amigo de su infancia.

programme.title: Spotlight on Christmas

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! GX

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: La historia detrás de…

programme.title: One Piece - Arabasta Saga: ¡La pesadilla se acerca! Esta es la base del Clan Suna Suna
programme.desc: A medida que se acerca la hora del cañonazo, Vivi y los demás entran en pánico. Tras recibir la extraña ayuda de la Marina, Vivi se da cuenta de dónde está el cañonero. Mientras tanto, Luffy llega a la tumba real para combatir contra Crocodile.

programme.title: One Piece - Arabasta Saga: ¡Unas maravillosas alas! Soy Pell, el dios guardián del país
programme.desc: Quedan segundos hasta que se lance el cañonazo a la plaza, por lo que Vivi intenta desesperadamente llegar a la cima de la torre del reloj, pero se encontrará con que no será tan fácil evitar el desastre.

programme.title: One Piece - Arabasta Saga: ¡Te superaré! ¡Cae la lluvia en Alabasta!
programme.desc: Llega el final del largo combate entre Luffy y Crocodile. Mientras tanto, Vivi intenta desesperadamente que sus ciudadanos dejen de luchar entre ellos.

programme.desc: Con la derrota de Crocodile a manos de Luffy, Vivi logra calmar la revuelta y explicar lo que pasó. Mientras tanto, Smoker y Tashigi se retiran de Alabasta.

programme.title: One Piece - Arabasta Saga: ¡El banquete de los piratas y la operación de huida de Alabasta!
programme.desc: El rey Cobra celebra un banquete en honor de Luffy y compañía. Luego de relajarse un poco, los Sombreros de Paja planean su huida mientras Vivi se debate si seguir como princesa o convertirse en pirata.

programme.title: One Piece - Arabasta Saga: ¡Comenzó aquel día! ¡Vivi cuenta la historia de su aventura!
programme.desc: Mientras los Sombrero de Paja y Bon clay intentan escapar de la Marina, Vivi se dispone a dar un discurso frente a todo su reino y así también comunicar su decisión a Luffy y los demás.

programme.title: One Piece - Arabasta Saga: ¡El aroma del peligro! ¡El séptimo miembro es Nico Robin!
programme.desc: Luego de partir de Alabasta para continuar su viaje por el Grand Line, los Sombrero de Paja se sorprenden al ver a Nico Robin en su barco.

programme.title: One Piece - Arabasta Saga: ¡El primer paciente! La historia no revelada de la Rumble Ball
programme.desc: Los Sombrero de Paja hacen un alto en una isla remota para descansar. Mientras cuida el barco, Chopper aprovecha para contarle a Robin la historia sobre su primer paciente.

programme.title: One Piece - Arabasta Saga: ¡El levantamiento de la navegadora! ¡Por el sueño firme!
programme.desc: Durante el viaje, los Sombrero de Paja recogen a un extraño vendedor. Nami decide comprarle papel para dibujar sus mapas, aunque le costará encontrar la tranquilidad para hacerlo, por lo que se enfada con el resto de la tripulación

programme.title: Kamen Rider Agito
programme.desc: Shouichi se mete en problemas y termina siendo arrestado, sospechoso de haber matado a Tomoko Miura. Creyendo en la inocencia de Shouichi, Mana acude a Makoto y le pide que libere a Shouichi.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Agito
programme.desc: Tomoko Miura, que conocía el pasado de Shouichi, es asesinada. Mana intenta encontrar pistas sobre el pasado de Shouichi con Makoto, usando sus poderes secretos sobre las pertenencias de Tomoko.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Agito
programme.desc: Makoto, una vez más, regresa como usuario de la armadura G3, gracias a su actuación, prediciendo el ataque de un Desconocido.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Agito
programme.desc: Pronto llega el cumpleaños número 17 de Mana. Al recordar con cariño a su padre, decide visitar la casa en la que vivía, que ahora está abandonada, y casualmente se encuentra con Makoto y su compañero de clase Konno.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Agito
programme.desc: Shouichi sufre un mordisco de un Desconocido. Al igual que con otras víctimas, sería llevado a la muerte dentro de las 24 horas.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Agito

programme.title: Kamen Rider Agito

programme.title: Kamen Rider Agito
programme.desc: Aki confiesa que ella era la novia de Shouichi antes de que sufriera amnesia. En medio de esto, Ryo se transforma y lucha para proteger a Aki, colapsando por las secuelas de su transformación.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Agito

programme.title: Death Note

programme.title: Death Note

programme.title: Death Note

programme.title: Death Note

programme.title: Death Note

programme.title: Death Note

programme.title: Death Note

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: El Defensor
programme.desc: Lance y su equipo son los guardaespaldas del jefe de la NSA, quien es enviado por el presidente a una reunión secreta en un hotel vacío en las afueras de Bucarest. Durante la reunión, el hotel es atacado.

programme.title: El expreso del miedo
programme.desc: Un experimento para solucionar el calentamiento global acabó matando a la mayoría de la vida existente en el planeta, los únicos supervivientes fueron los pasajeros del Snowpiercer,.

programme.title: Por Accidente para Siempre
programme.desc: Simon, el verdadero autor de las novelas románticas de 'Sally Carmichael', oculta su identidad para mantener su reputación.

programme.title: The Girl Next Door
programme.desc: Un estudiante de secundaria se enamora de su vecina, una hermosa actriz pornográfica.

programme.title: Bajo el Mismo Cielo

programme.title: A Cure for Wellness
